claims.text: Exclude medical and substance causes first, eg hyperthyroidism, acute coronary syndrome, substance use or withdrawal.
claims.quote: Finally, the symptoms must not be better explained by a general medical condition (such as hyperthyroidism or an acute coronary syndrome) or by substance use or withdrawal, or by another psychiatric disorder
claims.locator: Diagnosis of Panic Attacks and Panic Disorder

claims.text: Common coexisting medical conditions: cardiac arrhythmias, hyperthyroidism, asthma, COPD.
claims.quote: Common comorbid medical conditions include cardiac arrhythmias, hyperthyroidism, asthma, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

claims.text: Palpitations point to hyperthyroidism or drug effects, including withdrawal.
claims.quote: Palpitations: Hyperthyroidism, drug effects including withdrawal

claims.text: Thyroid function tests with thyroid symptoms or signs, on lithium, or over 40 with new psychiatric symptoms.
claims.quote: Thyroid function tests: Patients taking lithium, those with symptoms or signs of thyroid disease, and those > 40 years with new-onset psychiatric symptoms (particularly females or patients with a family history of thyroid disease)

claims.text: Withdrawal from alcohol, barbiturates or benzodiazepines can cause anxiety.
claims.quote: Withdrawal from alcohol, barbiturates, or benzodiazepines may cause psychiatric symptoms (eg, anxiety) in addition to symptoms of physical withdrawal.

claims.text: Toxicology screen with recent substance use or signs of intoxication.
claims.quote: Toxicology screening (eg, urine drug screen, blood alcohol level) is done if the patient has a recent history of substance use disorder or physical signs suggesting intoxication or recent substance use (eg, needle marks).
